Source revision: ddd58cb4673e06a022955d9041f261fb816a849f

The service image recipes and the image tag script under images/, the
documents under testdata/xynolog-docs/, the workflows under
testdata/xynolog-workflows/ and the Desktop Control API schema under
testdata/desktop/ are reference fixtures copied at that revision, with the
project's names renamed to Xynolog since. Tests read every one of them. They
are not xynolog's build or release workflows. Update them deliberately when
the contracts they hold change.

The Xynolog Go SDK remains an external dependency pinned in go.mod; the SDK
source is not copied into this repository.
